# Mosaic example attribution

The native application setup adapts the Vulkan voxel example from
[yesitsfebreeze/mosaic](https://github.com/yesitsfebreeze/mosaic/tree/ab4f95d210bbaf4369fc471173c1a10b9ed1dcc5/dev/examples/voxel/vulkan).
This renderer is an altered version of that example, with a different cell format,
scene, materials and half-cell intersections. It is not the original Mosaic example.

The original source distribution's license is preserved in `MOSAIC_LICENSE.txt`.
Mosaic's compiler, standard library and Vulkan runtime remain an external dependency;
they are not copied into this repository.
